p3a_pairs.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row deriving the revision != deletion guarantee from the decision-relationship invariant (e.g. a decision revision must not delete the superseded decision's record) would establish a real dependency; plausible in principle but not found stated in the rows reviewed.
